reviews.title: Great Desk For the Price!!!
reviews.comment: Love the desk! Clean sleek look! Building it only took about 30 min, very easy to assemble. Given how the desk is made, you can do great cable management and mount ur power strip or tie up any wires to the bottom of the desk for a cleaner look!  It’s sturdy and well built for the price but the only thing to watch out for is putting the middle bars on the bottom of the legs. over tightening can cause the legs to cave in and be dented around the bolt due to the hallow legs. I recommend you to install the black plastic feet caps into the bottom leg bars before screwing in the bolts for the middle support from leg to leg. Or you won’t be able to get the feet caps in when tight. Other wise, I’m very happy with the product and shipping care was very neat! No damage found anywhere!
reviews.author: Lucas

reviews.title: Great investment.
reviews.comment: Sturdy, easy to assemble, and looks good. This desk was worth the investment. Well built and rather quick to assemble when you have parts and pieces organized. A second helper is a bonus to hand you the next parts needed while  following the assembly chart, but not necessary. When finished, it felt sturdy and indeed stays sturdy even when you outfit it with whatever desktop items you have. It looks good and is even larger than it seems with great depth so you aren’t forced to be just inches away from your monitors. It comes with clear corner bumpers, but the adhesive seemed old or ‘melted’ so getting the backs off of the tiny sections in the bumpers was challenging. The bumpers also will come off easily due to their adhesive weakness, but that can be easily remedied with your own double sided tape of some sort if you choose. I would recommend this desk to anyone looking for something worth the price, well built (if you build it right, of course), and fashionable. Be mindful that the underside edge of the tabletop has very little space until you reach the frame, so clamps or modifications relying on some sort of lip edge can be hit or miss. Very happy with this desk. I am confident it will last a very long time no matter what it is used for.
reviews.author: ATik

reviews.title: A Workhorse Printers Table for the Last 9 Years
reviews.comment: Background: Purchased this desk to place my regular and 3d printers in my office. Wanted something that was sturdy, and the specs called for carrying capacity of up to 900 lbs. It was $155, which was a little dear for me then. Pros: 1. It is sturdy. Keeps the 2 printers from moving it or the printers themselves from vibrating or rocking. The legs are strong and well made. 2. Decent looks. It almost has industrial looks, yet looks just at home in my office. 3. The height is just right to align with my other desks, without looking too off from those surfaces. 4. I like the Teak color. It has been discontinued. I was debating between that or full black color. 5. The finish is decent, not many blemishes. 6. The packaging was good and so was the setup. Cons - rather improvements: 1. The teak veneer has shown some wear along the corners. Granted it may have been from the move and some handling while doing so. 2. One of the screws does not go flush with the surface, it does not make the table wiggle, but if I am down on the floor, it just looks odd. Moved that leg in the back to keep my OCD from getting in high gear. Bottom-line: This desk has served its purpose and then some. It is a good looking, sturdy device that has gone through serious movements and vibrations from the printers, but seems to have been holding well. Will buy it again.
reviews.author: Z-06

reviews.title: Sturdy, Stylish, and Perfect for Any Home Office Setup
reviews.comment: The Tribesigns Modern Computer Desk is exactly what I needed to upgrade my workspace. Assembly was surprisingly easy — all the parts were labeled, the instructions were clear, and everything lined up perfectly. I had it fully put together in under 30 minutes. Once assembled, the desk feels very solid. No wobbling, no shaking, and the metal frame gives it a sturdy, high-quality feel. The desktop surface is spacious enough for multiple monitors, speakers, and accessories, with plenty of room left over for writing or organizing. The finish looks clean and modern, adding a really nice touch to the room. The only downside that I noticed was the ability to mount anything to the edge of the desk. If you are looking to use a monitor stand that requires clamping you may have issues with having enough space on the underside due to the support bracing of the tabletop.
reviews.author: Bill Welcher

reviews.title: None of the issues you read on Negative Reviews
reviews.comment: I was a little wary from some of the reviews on this desk.  First, I was worried about the shipping.  It arrived with no issues.  It was packed well with styrofoam  surrounding all sides of the desk (see pic).  There were some small holes in the outside of the shipping box but did not penetrate the styrofoam.  Second, I was worried about the writing surface of the desk.  While there is a very slight texture to the desktop (see pics), it had zero effect on me writing on it.  I took a single sheet of paper and a pen and wrote what I wanted cleanly with no problems.  I could barely feel the texture when writing, but caused me no problems.  I guess if you are a calligrapher and write with fine tip pens, maybe you have an issue???  I'm really not sure what the issue is with some folks writing on this desk.  Third, I was worried about the sturdiness of the desk.  Relatively speaking, it is a cheap desk and didn't want to deal with a wobbly desk.  I saw there were a few other brands that had a very similar desk, but I went with Tribesigns because the desk weighed about 30% more and supposedly supports 900 lbs on it (competitors were around 300 lbs).  It looked like the the additional weight was in the thickness of the table top and the additional support in the legs.  I decided if a desk is going to be sturdy, Tribesigns was the best bet.  After the desk was put together, no issues at all with wobbling.  It does only weight circa 60 lbs so you can bump it and move it more easily than say the desks that weigh hundreds of pounds (that you pay a lot more money for), but that is to be expected.  When I write or type of the desk, not a single issue...nice and sturdy.  Lastly, I was worried about the quality of the desk.  I wanted to attach a metal compact pencil drawer to the particle board table top (see pic).  I wasn't sure how the desk would hold to drilling, screwing, and the weight of the drawer but ran into absolutely zero problems.  It was a nice addition to the desk.  As far as the assembling of the desk, I ran into none of the problems others talked about.  The only thing I noticed is the legs will very slightly bow if you tighten the screws really tight (legs are hallow).  I didn't tighten mine overly tight...just nice and snug...didn't effect the sturdiness.  If I had to complain about anything with this desk, it would be the support bar that hangs under the desk.  It takes up about 2 more inches of space and when you add it to the 1 inch table top, you lose 3 inches of the height.  I'm 6'3 and losing any height in a desk is kind of a pain, but I decided to work around it...what is losing an inch or two off a 29+ inch high desk top...it wasn't worth me not buying the desk.  The other complaint I had is I couldn't find the 63 inch desk anywhere and had to go with the 55 inch.  Again, not a deal breaker, but did like that option.  Lastly, for my own selfish reasons, I wish there was a support bar that ran at the back bottom of the desk.  I could use it as a pedestal but more importantly to hide wires that run on the floor (i.e. power cord from wall outlet to computer, etc.).  The desk does not come equipped with any cable management  features, so I will have to get creative in how to hide/blend wires with the desk.  Overall, I recommend this desk to anyone that is looking for a no frills budget desk.  It is not the most exciting (from a features standpoint) but the quality is really good (for what you pay) and looks really nice in the room.
reviews.author: Richard
